name: counterfactual-risk-v1
purpose: Pre-search blueprint/no-op gate for one fixed anchored candidate

rule.decision: search iff risk_metric <= maximum_risk; otherwise blueprint no-op

allowed: largest player-specific counterfactual root-L2 uncertainty proxy
forbidden: candidate utility against an exact responder
information_contract.current_proxy_warning: The exact lab supplies realized leaf error. A deployable successor must supply a conservative prediction before search.
information_contract.timing_warning: Reported avoided cost covers reference search only, not future neural inference or uncertainty calibration.

derivation.deduplication: canonical JSON of the complete run config
derivation.selection_rationale: Use the round 2e-4 threshold below the first observed failure; prefer a falsifiable conservative baseline over fitting a nonlinear classifier.

holdout_preregistration.seeds: 100-109 for kuhn2 and 100-104 for kuhn3; none appeared in derivation
holdout_preregistration.rule_retuning: prohibited until both holdout families are reported

advance_gate.efficiency: selected improvement per reference search millisecond exceeds unconditional search
